the columban young adults is a relatively new group for those aged 18 - 35 in the diocese, who are seeking a community of like-minded young adults who have christ at the centre of their lives. our november event will be a holy hour and meditation on thursday 19 november, 7:00pm at our lady of lourdes church, steelstown, derry, delivered by recently retired bishop donal mckeown. the meditation will be followed by solemn benediction and then refreshments. we are actively seeking new members - please come along and bring a friend! for any further information please contact us at
columbanyoungadults@gmail.com
